verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible top-to-bottom order (badge, logo, can, headline, copy, CTA), but the background circle is stretched into a tall oval, the NEW FLAVOR badge sits awkwardly above the logo and is almost as wide as the column, and the bottom ~90px is dead space below the CTA. B puts the logo and headline first, but it moves the NEW FLAVOR badge to the bottom as a big orange pill stacked over the CTA, so it reads as a second, competing button. That buries the real CTA and separates the badge from the product, and the can floats low inside the same distorted oval.
